Dense Is Not Enough: Hierarchical Supervision Allocation for Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: LENS-OPD allocates teacher supervision hierarchically across student trajectories and improves agent task performance. Full text describes a training method, not deployment cost/compression/serving evidence; an efficient deployed student is only a possible later application.

records.title: Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models
records.reason: GFPR iterates categorical belief states; full text covers puzzles/sequences and a 201M language model using 24 Picard steps. It proposes recurrent reasoning but does not demonstrate reduced inference compute; adjacent test-time-compute architecture work.

records.title: Learning Dynamics of Continual Learning: A Unified View of Data Attribution, Forgetting, and Plasticity Loss
records.reason: Primary text analyzes token/layer-wise continual-learning update effects and future plasticity. Packet links to recurrent-state/Qwen architecture lineages, so the body was checked; contribution is training dynamics/diagnostics, not inference-time efficiency.
